Scientific interpretation reports aligned to frozen Python 1.2.0

etr_native_source_text_inference.Rd

Nine Python-free, strictly descriptive reporting functions for generalized function-on-scalar regression predictions and profile contrasts, functional mixed-effects covariance sensitivity, multivariate IAAFT generation, and surrogate-based multivariate nonlinearity inference, marginal generalized FoSR fitting, within-trial mixed-effects diagnostics and sparse univariate/multivariate PACE.

Usage

etr_generalized_function_on_scalar_prediction_reporting_text(result)
etr_generalized_function_on_scalar_mean_difference_reporting_text(result)
etr_functional_mixed_effects_covariance_sensitivity_reporting_text(result)
etr_multivariate_iaaft_reporting_text(result)
etr_multivariate_surrogate_nonlinearity_reporting_text(result)
etr_generalized_function_on_scalar_reporting_text(result, band = NULL)
etr_functional_mixed_effects_residual_reporting_text(result)
etr_sparse_mfpca_reporting_text(result, digits = 3L)
etr_sparse_fpca_reporting_text(result, digits = 3L)

Arguments

band

Optional predeclared generalized function-on-scalar coefficient band.

digits

Nonnegative scientific reporting precision; restricted to 15 digits in R.

result

A validated native R list representing the relevant source result, containing explicit scalar identifiers, scientific metadata and inference diagnostics.

Value

A manuscript-oriented character scalar; no statistical estimator, bootstrap, interval or model selection is recalculated.

Details

Scientific limitations are preserved: no between-grid simultaneous coverage claims, no automatic covariance model selection, and rejection of a declared surrogate null is not proof of deterministic chaos. Input acceptance is a conservative native R record subset rather than the full Python frozen dataclass and NumPy domain. Source-contract differences remain unresolved and no full certification is inferred from matching example text.
